macro.headline: Geopolitical Tensions Fuel Commodity Rally and Inflation, Keeping 'Higher for Longer' Rate Stance Intact
themes: **Elevated Geopolitical Risk & Commodity Premium:** Increased US-Iran tensions and the ongoing Ukraine conflict are adding a significant risk premium to oil and gas prices. This, coupled with safe-haven demand, is supporting gold prices. This environment provides a strong tailwind for energy and select materials sectors.

**Sticky Inflation & Hawkish Central Banks:** Rising commodity prices, combined with persistent services inflation, are cementing expectations for central banks (RBA, Fed) to maintain a 'higher for longer' interest rate stance. Recent stronger-than-expected US jobs data further pushes back rate cut expectations globally, creating a headwind for rate-sensitive and growth sectors.

**Subdued Consumer & Economic Headwinds:** High interest rates and sustained cost-of-living pressures (exacerbated by rising energy prices) continue to weigh on consumer confidence and discretionary spending. This directly impacts consumer-facing industries and sectors reliant on household disposable income.
